notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Updated game engine
Made some optimizations and tweaks
Made some changes in UI
Added support of user's images in Puzzle Mode
Enhanced controls in Puzzle Mode
Added camera controls with WASD keys in Puzzle Mode
Added background effects in first scene
Added movement of sky
Added new game mode "Memory Game"
